- `/Users/kys1207/novel-repo/finance_fetcher/downloads/college_2010_2014_projection/college_2010_2013_asset_projection_btc_100m_sell_dec.csv`
- Result:

  - Sold Dec 2013 around $754.
  - About 301.6 billion KRW from BTC.
  - Total assets around 314.7 billion KRW.
- This is too large for quiet canon.

Capped staged sale to 100 billion KRW:

- `/Users/kys1207/novel-repo/finance_fetcher/downloads/college_2010_2014_projection/college_2010_2013_asset_projection_btc_100m_capped_100b.csv`

- BTC sale cash total: 100 billion KRW by 2013-11.
- Remaining BTC exists in calculation but should be handled carefully to avoid making the character too public.
- This is the preferred canon version.
